en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate church with tall spires and a prominent clock tower, surrounded by trees and a paved walkway. The Swedish text on the image reads 'Kyrkan, Sundsvall', indicating that the church is located in Sundsvall, Sweden. The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text, a postage stamp from Sweden (SVERIGE) valued at 10 öre, and a postal mark. The postcard is addressed to 'Fru Hilma Dahlgren' in 'Höge, Indal'. The publisher is 'J. Sunessons Bokhandel, Sundsvall'.
